newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were softer on Wednesday, traders said.
Weaker crude and U.S. gasoline prices for much of the day exerted bearish pressure, knocking $2 off NWE levels.
Naphtha also lost about $2 amid very sparse physical and swap activity. Petchem demand looked relaxed.
Low sulphur fuel oil was weaker again amid looming supply and forecasts of poor Italian buying.
Gas oil shed 25 cents. Heating oil and low sulphur diesel premiums were steady to 50 cents higher. Volumes were moderate.
